prerequisites: General knowledge of strength of materials

learning_outcomes.text: General knowledge and practical skills for the use of data base of the properties of contemporary materials, necessary for the material selection of a concrete application.

syllabus_topics: Mechanical, technological and running properties and characteristics of materials
Selection of material using the Ashby’s diagram
Definition of the users’ properties of products
Selection of material depending on the shape, running conditions and manufacturing technology of products
Economic, ergonomic and aesthetic requirements for the selection of material for a concrete product
assessment_rules: The final grade is formed by taking into account the results of assessments and two control tests carried out during the semester. The type of exam is written.
institution: University Of Ruse Angel Kanchev — Industrial Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
